03 / OUR APPROACH

PREPARATION IS EVERYTHING

EVERY PANEL.
EVERY DETAIL.

The visible finish is only part of the job. We start by understanding the damage and planning the right repair.

That means looking closely at the panel, discussing the work with you, and agreeing on an estimate before we begin. Preparation, colour, fit and finish all get attention through the process.

01

INSPECT THE DAMAGEWe look at the affected paint and bodywork before advising on the repair.

02

EXPLAIN THE OPTIONSYou know what is proposed and what it will cost before work starts.

03

REVIEW THE FINISHWe check the completed repair against the agreed work.
